//: Copy to updater-bot/config.json (git-ignored). Every field can also come from the environment - see README.md.
//botToken: Bot token used by the publisher. The token baked into the app only needs View Channel + Read Message History.
//webhookUrl: Alternative to botToken: a channel webhook (no bot needed to publish). Discord cannot edit webhook messages without an id, so the script keeps one in .state.json.
//hmacKey: Optional. Same value as updater.hmacKey in auth.json; when set the manifest is signed and the app refuses unsigned ones.
